content.text: {"id": "mm6839a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC analyzed hospital discharge data from the 2000–2015 Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project (HCUP)"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the rate of HCV infection increased from 0.8 (95% CI = 0.7–0.9) to 4.1 (95% CI = 3.7–4.4) per 1,000 deliveries"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "The U.S. rate of HCV infection at delivery increased from 0.8 per 1,000 live births in 2000 to 4.1 in 2015"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "HCV infection rates at delivery were significantly higher among women with opioid use disorder than among those who did not have opioid use disorder."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "data from HCUP’s National Inpatient Sample (NIS, 2000–2015)"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Joinpoint regression was used to model the average percentage change in HCV infection and opioid use disorder rates over time"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Survey-specific analysis techniques accounted for clustering, stratification, and weighting."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Joinpoint regression was used to model the average percentage change in HCV infection and opioid use disorder rates over time"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Polytomous logistic regression models were used to calculate unadjusted odds ratios (ORs) and 95% CIs"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated using SAS (version 9.4; SAS Institute)."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["outcome_types"]}
